niche.habitat: Upper cloud decks (0.5–2 bar), drifting downward
niche.active: Continuous, driven by starlight and chemical gradients

body: Tiny, crimson-hued colonies that drink the dim red starlight through red-shifted pigments. They carry pressurized mineralized spores that burst into rapid mitosis as they sink through the ammonia haze.

links: Drifts downward under 2.6 g gravity
Crosses adiabatic lapse rate of 2 K/km
Reaches >10 bar cooking zone
Forces rapid mitosis before protein denaturation

skill.effect: Releases 3 defensive spores on descent, dealing 12 heat damage and slowing pursuit

chains.weakness: Completely immobile and vulnerable during the 4-second mitosis phase

journal.en: They race the oven, betting their lives on a single division.

analogues.mechanism: see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

chains.trait: Red-shifted near-infrared photopigments in upper decks
links: Star at 5.2 AU yields 3.5% Earth flux
Photon starvation limits visible light capture
Absorbs 600–900 nm NIR bands
Enables anoxygenic photosynthesis in dim haze

skill.effect: In dim cloud layers, its infrared pulses strike strongly while its body shifts nearby to avoid counterattacks.

chains.weakness: Suffers neural static and reduced accuracy under bright UV flares

journal.en: They drink the near-infrared whisper of a distant sun.

links: Azotosome lipids cross-link under high pressure
Cross-linking forms a temporary, damage-resistant membrane seal
Rapid ascent to low-pressure zones breaks bonds, causing internal gas expansion
Root: F13, F16

skill.effect: It tightly seals its outer membrane to shrug off blows for a short while, though forcing this seal in thin air causes its body to slowly unravel from the strain.

chains.weakness: Using it in thin upper clouds causes rapid tissue expansion and movement penalty

journal.en: They armor up in the crush, only to bleed out when the sky thins.

links: Shield DNA from high-pressure cooking
Lethal zone begins above supercritical transition
No surface means descent is permanent mortality
Selects for durable dispersal units

skill.effect: It hardens a mineralized spore casing over its body to absorb incoming strikes, and each impact leaves the armor thicker and more resilient.

journal.en: Nature's tin cans falling to their doom.

links: Fuel metabolism where light fails
Insolation drops precipitously with depth
Cloud decks scatter and absorb stellar flux
Sustains survival in permanent shadow

skill.effect: It draws on stored ammonia to lash out with a corrosive strike while simultaneously drawing nutrients back into its own flesh.

temperament: Frantic, prolific, and utterly indifferent to individual survival.
secrets: Rapid mitotic division <- heat stress <- 2.6g gravity + adiabatic lapse rate -> Skill 'Spore Burst' (Control): releases a cloud of fast-growing allies that temporarily boost local biomass. Weakness: Spores detonate if pressure drops too high (decompression).
moments: Watching a crimson bloom erupt mid-fall, a living hourglass ticking against the cooking zone.
